# Cost per iteration of an order-dependent loop run by ONE device thread (a Gauss-Seidel sweep), against the host cost of one scalar read.
using CUDA, JSON3
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))
function gs!(u, f, n, reps)
    for _ in 1:reps
        for i in 2:n-1
            u[i] = 0.5 * (u[i - 1] + u[i + 1] + f[i])      # in place: iteration i reads what i-1 wrote
        end
    end
    return nothing
end
function runsum!(x, y, out, n)
    acc = 0.0
    for i in 1:n
        acc += x[i]
        y[i] = acc * x[i]                                    # pv_a16: a running sum read in its own loop
    end
    out[1] = acc
    return nothing
end
rows = Any[]
for n in (64, 1024, 16384, 262144)
    u = CUDA.rand(Float64, n); f = CUDA.rand(Float64, n)
    reps = max(1, div(2_000_000, n))
    @cuda threads = 1 blocks = 1 gs!(u, f, n, 1); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns(); @cuda threads = 1 blocks = 1 gs!(u, f, n, reps); CUDA.synchronize(); dt = (time_ns() - t0) / 1e3
    push!(rows, Dict("kernel" => "gs_sweep_1_thread", "n" => n, "reps" => reps, "us_per_element" => dt / (reps * (n - 2))))
    x = CUDA.rand(Float64, n); y = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); o = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1)
    @cuda threads = 1 blocks = 1 runsum!(x, y, o, n); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns(); for _ in 1:20; @cuda threads = 1 blocks = 1 runsum!(x, y, o, n); end; CUDA.synchronize(); dt = (time_ns() - t0) / 1e3 / 20
    push!(rows, Dict("kernel" => "running_sum_1_thread", "n" => n, "us_per_element" => dt / n, "us_per_launch" => dt))
end
res["serial"] = rows
# the same running sum as a host loop over a device array: two scalar reads and one write per element
let n = 256
    x = CUDA.rand(Float64, n); y = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    function hostsum(x, y, n)
        acc = 0.0
        CUDA.@allowscalar for i in 1:n
            acc += x[i]; y[i] = acc * x[i]
        end
        return acc
    end
    hostsum(x, y, n); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns(); for _ in 1:20; hostsum(x, y, n); end; CUDA.synchronize()
    res["host_running_sum_us_per_element"] = (time_ns() - t0) / 1e3 / 20 / n
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
